main_text.p: נַעַר m. Pueritia, Infantia: Juventus, Adolescentia: Concusio, Excusio. בְּנַעַר In juventute ista, vel, cum juventa ista, Job.36.14. מִנַּעַר A pueritia, vel, Pra concussione, Psalm.88.16.
נְעוּרִים f.p. Pueritia, Adolescentia, Isa.54.6. Aff. בִּנְעוּרָיו In pueritia sua, Thren.3.27. נְעוּרֵיךָ Adolescentia tua, Mal.2.15. Et formâ fœm. מִנְּעוּרֹתֵיהֶם Inde à pueritia sua, Jerem.32.30.
נְעָרָה f. Stupa, quod ex lino Excussa: הַנְּעָרָה Stupæ, Jud. 16.9. לִנְעָרָה In stupam, Jesa.1.31.

נפח Spiravit, Flavit, Efflavit, Perflavit, Suffla-vit: Præt. וָאֶנְפְּחָה Et sufflabo, Ezech.22.21. Pyh. Part. נָפַח Sufflatus, Job.20.26. Hiph.Præt. הֵפִיחַ Spirare fecerim, Anhelantè reddiderim, id est, defatigaverim, Job.31.39. וְהֵפִיחָם Et diffiatis, flata dispellitis, Mal.1.13.
מַפָּח m. Follis, q.d. Sufflatorium, Jerem.6.26.
נֶפֶךְ m. Chrysoprasus, gemmæ species, Exod.28. v.18. Onkelos, Smaragdum reddit.

נפל Cecidit; Dejecit vel Demisit se, Accidit: Concidit, Decidit, Excidit, Incidit, Procidit, Defecit, Ruit, Corruit, Irruit. Præter. נָפַל Procidit, 2.Sam.19.18. &c. Chald. Præter. נְפַל Procidebat, Dan.2.46. נָפְלוּ Ceciderunt, Dan.3.23. Particip. נָפְלִין Procidentes, Dan.3.7. Futur. יִפֹּל Prociderit, Dan.3.v.6. Acciderit, Est.7.20. תִּפְלוֹן Prociditote, Dan.7.v.5. Hiph. הִפִּיל Fecit, Effecit aut fivit cadere vel decidere, Dejiciendum curavit, Abjecit, Dejecit, Ejecit, Injecit, Projecit, Prostravit. Præterit. הִפִּיל פּוּר Jussit conjici Pur, id est fortem, Esth.3.7. הִפִּלְתִּי Feci ut caderent, Josh.23.4. Hithp. הִתְנַפֵּל Prouere, Prosternere se.
